verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a developer framework, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no interactive or runnable API reference: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt and markdown docs are machine-readable documentation, an adjacent feature rather than an interactive reference with runnable examples.
